camera_policy: Explicit per-case camera map: regular/front and from-rest/side authored inspection; fakie uses the actual production chase camera and HUD. Every117 consecutive native push/release tick is recorded. Brake/pop stay physically checked but visually unreviewed.
capture_selection_policy: Every physical phase/check/native trace still runs. The natural-three selection records all117consecutive ticks (72push+45release) of regular/front, from-rest/side and fakie/productionchase; brake/pop are physically checked but visually UNREVIEWED. No discarded phase is claimed as a visual pass.

fixture_policy: Declared default-spawn restarts, regular/fakie initial headings and two signed6m/s moving starts. Separate from-rest, brake and6/18-tick pop cases use actual input without motion seeds; see push_fixture_policy.
pixel_storage_policy: Every declared native640 RGBA8 pixel is hashed and losslessly encoded without resizing or upsampling; consecutive selected physics frames remain60Hz. This is diagnostic motion, not finalresolution acceptance.
push_fixture_policy: Regular/fakie moving-start cases seed signed6m/s and one initial heading on the same native spine; a separate actual push-from-rest case seeds no motion. Brake and6/18-tick push-to-pop interruptions use actual mapped input from rest.
raw_frame_policy: Lossless input PNGs remain in the ignored staging directory; published movies are fully decoded and source-frame hashes/timeline plus selected lossless review frames are retained.
render_fence_policy: Production processing is fenced by a same-frame zero timer; each selected frame uses the natural render loop and awaits frame_post_draw, with unchanged physics/process counters. Independent coloured 3D markers at actual projected head/board and current Canvas swatches prove camera/Canvas boundary synchronization.
resolution_scope: Native640x400 diagnostic motion; no upsampling, finaltexture/H1/targetFPS or finalAAA claim. Separate native1280Main/closeups own surface fidelity.
